high_level_description: This image captures a serene beach scene at sunset. The sky is painted with hues of orange, pink, and yellow, transitioning into a darker blue as it meets the horizon. The sun is partially visible on the right side of the image, casting a warm glow over the ocean and the sand. The ocean waves gently lap against the shore, creating white foam as they recede back into the water. The sand appears smooth and golden, with some small rocks and debris scattered across its surface.
